info.title: Smart Lab Platform Basic API
info.description: Swagger 2.0 JSON for Apifox import. Covers phase 1 core backend APIs and current frontend compatibility endpoints.

get.summary: Compatibility endpoint for lab admin notice page

put.summary: Compatibility batch endpoint for lab admin notice page

get.summary: Compatibility endpoint for system admin notice page

put.summary: Compatibility batch endpoint for system admin notice page

ModuleNamePath.name: moduleName
ModuleNamePath.description: Environment page uses lab-software-environments, course-environment-requests, environment-templates.

Lab.description: Lab response object. The frontend maps labCode/labName/roomNo/labType/openStatus/deviceCount to code/name/room/type/status/devices.

Device.description: Device response object. The frontend maps deviceCode/deviceName/labName/ownerUsername to code/name/lab/owner for display. health, online, inventoryDate, warranty, usageHours, and maintenance are frontend-only display extensions.

Reservation.description: Reservation response object. The frontend prefers applicant/department/contact/lab/date/attendees/reviewer/note and also supports applicantName/labName/reservationDate/attendeeCount/reviewerName/reviewRemark.

RepairOrder.description: Repair order response object. The frontend prefers ticket/reporter/contact/lab/device/priority/assignee/result and also supports orderNo/reporterName/labName/deviceName/priorityLevel/assigneeName/resultDesc.

resultDesc.example: Repair completed and waiting for review

content.example: Please confirm the course environment after login.

User.description: User response object. Lab, device, and account dialogs need at least id/username/realName/roleName for selects.
